evidence.title: How much does it cost to own a cat? One expense jacks up the price

occurrences.checkable_against: Kimberly Palmer's NerdWallet cat ownership cost estimate
occurrences.quote_span: On average, Palmer said the cost of owning a cat is estimated to be about $2,015 per year, which could cost around $40,300 if your cat lives until they're 20 years old .
occurrences.speaker: Kimberly Palmer
occurrences.subject: cost of owning a cat
